market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $40,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76K needs to dip to $40K — a ~47% drawdown — by Dec 31, 2026 (~8 months). This is below historical bear-market floors but requires a sustained risk-off cascade. Probability roughly 15-22%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severe macro/credit shock or sustained ETF outflow could push BTC into a deeper bear market.
